verdict.rationale: First-party billing docs describe budgets that track actual spend against planned spend, with budget notifications. They also describe programmatic cost-control responses via Pub/Sub and a Billing REST API, which covers the budgets-and-alerts part of the story. The pack does not document any anomaly detection on spend. missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets and alerts are configurable from day one (e.g. at account creation or by default), independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts prevent surprise bills.
